dedupe_keys.name: artemis catastrophe bond and insurance linked securities deal directory and market dashboard

description: A directory of catastrophe bonds and insurance-linked securities deals since the market began. The Artemis page says the directory holds information on more than 1,000 catastrophe bonds and related transactions issued since the mid-1990s, listing for each the issuer, the cedent, the risks and perils covered, the size and the date, and that a market dashboard shows issuance and outstanding totals; the page shows 18.9 billion US dollars issued in 2026 and 65.6 billion outstanding, with deals up to August 2026. It is free to browse on the website. Coverage is global cat bond issuance. Caveats: the page read does not offer a bulk download or licence, and some cedents are listed as unknown. For simulation it shows which perils and regions have risk transferred to capital markets and how much cover exists after a disaster. A related catalogue record is the FEMA NFIP redacted policies.
